chunks: About the muhrim wearing two socks, he said: “Yes, and also the two leather slippers if he is compelled to them.”

key_terms.اضْطُرَّ: was compelled or forced by necessity
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim wear socks or leather slippers during ihram if necessary?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a muhrim may wear in the state of ihram. It indicates that wearing socks, and also leather slippers, is allowed in a case of necessity or compulsion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2615 - Rifa’ah ibn Musa asked Imam (as) about a Muhrim wearing socks (jawrabayn).
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and also leather slippers (khuffayn) if he is compelled to wear them."
